notes: new: Giveaway accounts now auto-stop. If Whatnot keeps refusing an account's entries, DropX pauses just that account and lets it enter again by itself.
new: Set a win cap to stop an account entering after a number of wins (per account or for all accounts).
fix: A passing network or proxy blip, or a banned account, no longer shows as 'token refused - sign in again'.
ui: The Settings tab now shows how each account was added - DropX generated, Created by hand, or Manual login.
fix: Removing an account now clears its proxy assignment too - removed accounts no longer linger in the proxy list.
fix: Real Whatnot handles are resolved more reliably when an account is made.
